summary: Healthy 29 y for ankle ORIF who snorted cocaine about 10 hours ago and still looks sympathomimetic (HR 110, BP 156/94, diaphoresis, 5 mm pupils), and who ate three slices of pizza at 0100 although the handoff says NPO since midnight.

asa.rationale: Healthy apart from substance use; urgent fracture.

decision.rationale: Ongoing signs of cocaine effect raise arrhythmia, ischemia, and hypertensive crisis risk; the fracture is reduced with good soft tissue, so waiting is reasonable. A fatty meal at 0100 also needs about 8 h. Reassess later today or tomorrow.

redFlags.finding: Recent cocaine with ongoing sympathomimetic signs
redFlags.evidence: UDS positive; intranasal use about 2100 to 2200; HR 110 to 124, BP 156 to 164/94 to 98, diaphoresis, mydriasis, jittery.
redFlags.implication: Coronary vasospasm, arrhythmia, hypertension under anesthesia.
redFlags.action: Delay until signs resolve; if forced to proceed avoid ketamine and unopposed beta blockade, benzodiazepines for agitation, treat hypertension with vasodilators.

redFlags.evidence: 4 West note: 3 slices of pepperoni pizza about 0100; transfer report says NPO since midnight; hydromorphone given.
redFlags.implication: Fatty meal needs 8 h; opioids and trauma slow emptying.
redFlags.action: Wait until at least 0900 or RSI.

redFlags.implication: Low withdrawal risk with weekend use, but watch.

redFlags.finding: Consent about an hour after IV hydromorphone
